historical_context_sources.title: Der Adventskranz: Bedeutung und Ursprung des Adventskranzes
historical_context_sources.authority_role: Official Catholic diocesan retrospective on Advent wreath history
historical_context_sources.claim_supported: Wichern introduced a multi-candle wreath in Hamburg in 1839; 4-candle form and Catholic uptake emerged later; first Cologne church example is described as reportedly 1925.
historical_context_sources.limitations: Historical synthesis, not archival proof of unique first occurrence or 1962 rite; source qualifies the 1925 claim.

historical_context_sources.title: Was ist Advent: Ursprung und Bedeutung der Vorweihnachtszeit
historical_context_sources.authority_role: Official Catholic diocesan witness to manger straw in German Catholic areas
historical_context_sources.claim_supported: In Catholic regions children put straw into a manger after good deeds. Combined with Catholic Culture this establishes practice across more than one setting.
historical_context_sources.limitations: Neither Cologne nor Catholic Culture proves that the custom originated in France, that it was universal or that it was employed everywhere.

historical_context_sources.title: Y tú, ¿cómo celebras las posadas?

historical_context_sources.authority_role: Mexican government historical account distinguishing competing origin theories
historical_context_sources.claim_supported: The Acolman 1587 tradition is one historical attribution; other writers identify Andalusian transmission; colonial Mexican context is established but singular exact origin disputed.
historical_context_sources.limitations: Not a Catholic ritual authorization, nor proof of a fixed 1962 Mass celebration or mandatory parish house visits.

historical_context_sources.title: Background on Mary's Gardens
historical_context_sources.issuer: University of Dayton — Marian Library / International Marian Research Institute
historical_context_sources.authority_role: Specialist Marian library's archival history of modern Mary Garden projects
historical_context_sources.claim_supported: The first public United States Mary Garden was established at Woods Hole in 1932; the Philadelphia Mary's Gardens initiative began in 1951 and spread home-garden kits.
historical_context_sources.limitations: Medieval plant names do not prove that today's formal Mary Garden layout dates to the Middle Ages.

historical_context_policy.owner: Existing canonical custom ID, not a new customary attestation

supplemental_claim_sources.title: History and usage of Holy Water
supplemental_claim_sources.issuer: St Mary Basilica Archives — Rev. David O'Connor
supplemental_claim_sources.claim_supported: Catholics traditionally obtained blessed water from church, kept it in entrance or bedroom fonts at home, made the Sign of the Cross, and sometimes blessed children; devotional use is distinct from priestly blessing of the water.
supplemental_claim_sources.limitations: Pastoral account, not population-level frequency study, universal liturgical prescription, or authorization for lay people to perform reserved clerical rites.

supplemental_claim_sources.title: Mit Magdalena unterwegs — 2026 diocesan events including Emmausgang
supplemental_claim_sources.claim_supported: The Archdiocese announced an Emmausgang in Ruhpolding on Easter Monday, 6 April 2026, with walking stages and spiritual reflections. This corroborates actual contemporary Bavarian Catholic practice.
supplemental_claim_sources.limitations: A dated local event is not a recurrent universal schedule; an ecumenical activity in 2026 does not change the traditional 1962 Mass or mandate any route.

supplemental_claim_sources.title: Saint Nicolas en visite à Montois-la-Montagne
supplemental_claim_sources.issuer: Diocèse de Metz — communauté de paroisses Saint-Pierre de Jaumont
supplemental_claim_sources.claim_supported: On 7 December 2024, an individual portraying St Nicholas visited children at Saint-Nicolas Church in Montois-la-Montagne, distributing chocolates; a real local Lorraine Catholic practice of charitable gift-giving.
supplemental_claim_sources.limitations: Dated Lorraine parish report. Does not certify every Alsatian household, reconstruct early history, guarantee annual visits, or alter the 1962 liturgical calendar.

supplemental_claim_sources_policy.relation: One existing published custom ID; strengthens a bounded claim without changing 108 attestation source owners
